headline: Clinton executive order on a Presidential Advisory Council on HIV/AIDS, which advises on federal HIV/AIDS policy.
what_it_does: This 1995 executive order deals with a Presidential Advisory Council on HIV/AIDS. Based on the title, it appears to set up or organize a group that gives the President advice on HIV/AIDS. No summary was provided, so details such as who serves on the council and exactly what it does are not confirmed here.

who_it_affects.how: The council's advice may shape federal HIV/AIDS policies and programs that affect them.
People appointed to the council would serve as advisers to the President on HIV/AIDS issues.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed June 14, 1995; executive orders like this usually take effect when signed.
